scope: Targeted follow-up on existing approved records; not a repeated Phase 0 audit
privacy: No citizen names, contact details, identity numbers, application identifiers, opaque URLs, signatures or source certificate images are included.

facts: Existing trade applications show paid and approved states.
Bangla and English outputs appear as separate application rows.
Rows expose application details, applicant details, invoice printing and trade renewal actions.
Details include general, business and business-address information.
Edit controls and an approved-certificate warning exist in the rendered UI.
No edit, renewal, cancellation or approval was performed.

observations.limitation: One existing invoice is not an office-approved tariff or proof that every office/service uses this price. No payment was made.

facts: Submitting an existing approved reference opened a one-page English trade PDF in a separate browser tab.
The certificate includes business and address sections, a fiscal-year validity period, fee breakdown, signatory area and verification URL.
Statutory trade-license charges shown on the certificate differ from the platform processing invoice total. These must be separate fee concepts.
observations.limitation: Retrieval of an existing output does not establish successful new submission, payment settlement, approval authority, or the source issuance transaction.

unverified: The action and account that granted approval
Whether specific services auto-approve or require a separate approver
Union-specific approved tariffs and signatory authority
